narr: A slow moving thunderstorm brought flash flooding to a small portion of Fulton County on the afternoon of August 21st. Several roads reported high water and debris.||In Cambria County, road flooding occurred in East Taylor, Summerhill, and Middle Taylor. East Taylor and Middle Taylor townships declared local disaster declarations. Damage was to paved and unpaved roadways, streambeds, and vegetative areas.
ev: Flooding with water and debris over the roads was reported on Great Cove Road at Websters Mill and Big Cove Tannery Road.
Road flooding was reported in the Cito area.
